current_task_binding.dataset_name: Tsinghua FROM-GLC Year of Change to Impervious Surface

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global terrestrial coverage of transitions from pervious to artificial impervious surface.

analytical_capabilities: Map the spatial distribution and timing of conversion to artificial impervious surface
Reconstruct impervious extent for any year from 1985 through 2018
Quantify changes in impervious extent and derived impervious fraction
Detecting patterns of urban expansion and land development over time
Analyzing spatial heterogeneity and temporal trends in human-built land cover

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: change_year_index, an integer code from 34 for transition in 1985 to 1 for transition in 2018
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: The sole band is change_year_index. For valid codes 1 through 34, transition_year = 2019 - change_year_index. Reconstruct impervious extent at a target year by selecting pixels whose transition_year is less than or equal to that year. A value of 0 does not encode a dated transition in the 1985-2018 record. The asset is one static image, not one image per year, and its values are not impervious percentages.

current_task_binding.data_source: Tsinghua University and collaborating research institutions

observation_identity_contract.physical_object: artificial impervious land-surface extent and expansion timing
observation_identity_contract.source_lineage: Tsinghua FROM-GLC GAIA Landsat-based production lineage
observation_identity_contract.core_measurement_semantics: GAIA change-year or annual impervious-area observation
observation_identity_contract.non_material_variations: official/community mirror, archive, format, reprojection or derived annual masks retaining GAIA change-year information
observation_identity_contract.material_mismatches: another built-up or impervious-surface product without GAIA lineage

original_anchor_asset.asset_alias_policy: The Tsinghua FROM-GLC GAIA v1.0 change-year raster distributed by its authors, the official Earth Engine asset Tsinghua/FROM-GLC/GAIA/v10, and a demonstrably identical community mirror such as projects/sat-io/open-datasets/GAIA are admitted. Other impervious-surface, built-up-area and urban-land products are excluded.

repointed_from.why_former_anchor_was_incomplete: The former ID is a community mirror and is not present in the current dataset index. Its prompt also misdescribed GAIA as an annual ImageCollection of 0-100 impervious fractions.
repointed_from.why_new_anchor: Tsinghua/FROM-GLC/GAIA/v10 is the ready official catalog asset and the sole exact GAIA product match in the current dataset index. It is a single 30 m change-year image covering transitions from 1985 through 2018.
repointed_from.direction_consequence: Existing directions remain valid because they operationally use the same GAIA product family; this is an official-host repoint rather than an observable or product-family replacement.

directions.hypothesis_or_mechanism: 人工夜间光可能通过改变光周期信号和光合作用过程延迟或改变秋季叶片衰老，其影响受温度、经济发展和植被结构等因素调节。
directions.variables_and_data_use: 研究使用 CPON 和 PEP725 地面秋季物候记录，以及 MCD12Q2 Version 6.1 的 Greenup 和 Dormancy 指标；使用 NPP-VIIRS-like、DMSP-OLS、NPP-VIIRS 和 H-NTL-v2 表征年度或月度人工夜间光；使用 Global Artificial Impervious Area product 划定城市边界；使用 TerraClimate、CRU JRA v2.4 和 NorESM2-MM 提供气候变量，并结合 V cmax25、OCO-2、GPP、ET、FPAR、aboveground biomass、tree density、canopy height、Human Development Index、gross domestic product 和 per capita GDP 进行相关分析、因果分析、空间归因和秋季物候预测。
directions.method_paradigm: 关系机制与空间归因
directions.evidence_granularity: audited open full text Methods/Data section

directions.research_question: 研究评估如何利用开放地理空间数据刻画 Coimbatore 的城市发展和 built-up area 扩张，并估算城市屋顶用于食物、水和能源生产的潜力。
directions.hypothesis_or_mechanism: 开放建筑 footprint、GAIA 不透水地表扩张和 GHSL 长期 built-up surface 数据能够共同表征城市增长，并支持对屋顶资源利用潜力的估算。
directions.variables_and_data_use: 使用 GAIA 年度人工不透水面积地图分析 1988 至 2018 年的不透水地表扩张；使用 Google Open Buildings dataset v3 获取建筑 footprint 并计算屋顶面积；使用 GHSL global builtup surface 1975–2030 (P2023A) 分析长期 built-up surface 变化；再结合降雨、日照、作物产量和价格等参数估算屋顶农业、雨水收集和光伏潜力及收益。
directions.method_paradigm: 多源空间分析与决策支持
used_assets: annual maps of global artificial impervious area (GAIA) dataset
the global human settlement layer (GHSL): global builtup surface 1975–2030 (P2023A)
directions.evidence_granularity: audited open full text Methods/Data section

directions.research_question: 城市形态、植被、土地利用和不透水地表等因素如何影响 Travis County 昼间和夜间地表温度的空间分异？
directions.hypothesis_or_mechanism: 更高的不透水地表比例、更高的建筑和道路密度可能增强地表热积累，而植被覆盖和较高的天空可视因子可能促进降温，并且这些作用具有昼夜差异和空间异质性。
directions.variables_and_data_use: 研究以 Sentinel-3 SLSTR 生成的昼间和夜间 LST 合成为目标变量，并以 GAIA dataset 计算的 Impervious Surface Percent、USDA Forest Service 树冠覆盖、NLCD 土地利用、OpenStreetMap 道路网络、USGS Landsat Surface Reflectance 计算的 NDVI、建筑物矢量及其他街区形态和景观指标作为预测变量，统一汇总到街区尺度后进行标准化和空间统计分析。
directions.method_paradigm: 空间异质性机制分析
used_assets: City of Austin Open Data Portal
